Employee's job title or occupation at time of injury.

text: County and State Where Accident or Exposure Occurred?
description: Location (county and state) of the accident or exposure.
Name of the employer at time of injury.

Describe employer's business or product.
Mailing address for the employer.

text: Name of Worker's Compensation Insurance Co. or Self-Insured Employer
description: Carrier name or self-insured employer responsible for claim.
Federal Employer Identification Number of insurer.

text: Name and Address of Third Party Administrator (TPA) Used by the Insurance Company or Self-Insured Employer
description: TPA contact details, if used.
Federal Employer Identification Number of the TPA.
Employee wage amount at time of injury (numeric).

text: Specify per hr., wk., mo., yr., etc.
description: Specify pay period for the wage (e.g., per hr., wk., mo.).
Unit corresponding to wage amount.

text: Meals (In Addition to Wages, Employee Received)
description: Check if employee received meals in addition to wages.

text: Room (In Addition to Wages, Employee Received)
description: Check if employee received room in addition to wages.

text: Tips (In Addition to Wages, Employee Received)
description: Check if employee received tips in addition to wages.
Number of meals per week received (if applicable).
Number of days per week room is provided (if applicable).
Average weekly amount of meals/room/tips included.
Indicate if employee is paid overtime.

text: If Yes, After How Many Hours of Work Per Week?
description: Number of hours per week after which overtime pay begins.
Number of weeks worked in same kind of work in prior 52 weeks.
Total gross wages (excluding tips) for the reported weeks.

text: If Piece-Work, No. of Hrs. Excluding Overtime:
description: Number of hours for piece-work excluding overtime.
Start time of employee's usual work schedule (HH:MM).
Usual hours worked per day.
Usual hours worked per week.
Usual days worked per week.

text: Employer’s Usual Full-Time Schedule for This Type of Work at Time of Employee’s Injury
description: Employer's typical full-time schedule for the type of work.

text: Are there Other Part-Time Workers Doing the Same Work With the Same Schedule?
description: Indicate whether other part-time workers do the same work and schedule.
Number of other part-time workers doing the same work and schedule.

text: Number of Full-Time Employees Doing The Same Type Of Work:
description: Count of full-time employees performing the same work.
Date when the injury or occupational illness occurred.
Time of day when injury occurred; include AM/PM.
Last day employee worked before time off (if applicable).
Date employer was notified of the injury.
Date employee returned to work (if applicable).
Estimated date employee is expected to return to work.
Indicate if the injury resulted in death.
Date of employee's death if injury caused death.

text: Was This a Lost Time or Other Compensable Injury?
description: Indicate if this injury resulted in lost time or other compensable benefits.

text: Did Injury Occur Because of: Substance Abuse
description: Check if substance abuse contributed to the injury.

text: Did Injury Occur Because of: Failure to Use Safety Devices
description: Check if failure to use safety devices contributed to the injury.

text: Did Injury Occur Because of: Failure to Obey Rules
description: Check if failure to obey rules contributed to the injury.

text: Was Employee Treated in an Emergency Room?
description: Indicate whether treatment was provided in an ER.

text: Was Employee Hospitalized Overnight as an In-Patient?
description: Indicate whether the employee was admitted as an in-patient overnight.

text: Name and Address of Treating Practitioner and Hospital
description: Provide practitioner and hospital name and address where treated.

text: Case Number from the OSHA Log
description: OSHA log case number, if applicable.

text: Injury Description - Describe Activities of Employee When Injury or Illness Occurred and What Tools, Machinery, Objects, Chemicals, Etc. Were Involved.
description: Detailed description of activities and equipment involved.

text: What Happened to Cause This Injury or Illness? (Describe How The Injury Occurred)
description: Narrative describing how the injury occurred.

text: What Was The Injury or Illness? (State the Part of Body Affected and How It Was Affected)
description: Describe the injury/illness and body part(s) affected.
Name of the person preparing this report.
Phone number for the person preparing the report.
